statement: These are provisional performance-comparison values, separate from readiness DEMATEL and not claimed as expert consensus or empirical validation.
assumptions: Normalized criterion performance lies between zero and one.
Development performance weights remain replaceable and are not derived from DEMATEL prominence.
ELECTRE thresholds represent materially different performance on the normalized scale.
Formal approval requires structured expert elicitation, benchmark validation and sensitivity review.

artifacts.purpose: Criterion normalization and provisional criterion weights
Credibility, discrimination, indifference, preference and veto thresholds
